error[ZC-E0103]: zcube-server sent a reply the client can't read
  cause  the reply is not JSON
  fix    use the zcube that came with the server, or upgrade the older one
  more   zcube explain E0103 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0103.html
